author: The Current
description:
Trampled by Turtles’ frontman Dave Simonett talks about the album name, "Good Dogs"
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

What’s in a name? “Good Dogs” is the name of Trampled by Turtles’ 10th studio album, just released exclusively on vinyl on Friday, Nov. 20 (the streaming release will come in January 2027).  Ahead of the album release, Trampled by Turtles frontman Dave Simonett spoke with The Current’s Jill Riley about the new album’s name. “My son was opposed at first,” Simonett says with a laugh.

Simonett shares the origin of the album name, and he also describes how the album artwork came together. Watch more from Dave Simonett’s interview with Jill Riley in the video above.

Trampled by Turtles will celebrate the album release on Sunday, Nov. 22, at 2 p.m., with a concert at First Avenue. That concert is sold out, but you can listen to the live concert broadcast or watch a live video stream on The Current’s YouTube channel: https://www.
title: Trampled by Turtles’ frontman Dave Simonett on the album name, "Good Dogs"

author: The Current
description:
Low Cut Connie's Adam Weiner talks about how much the people at his shows mean to him
Support The Current: https://support.mpr.org/youtube or hit the Thanks button

Low Cut Connie’s Adam Weiner has noticed something interesting since touring resumed after the pandemic. “This little, kind of cult-y band, pre-pandemic, has turned into this thing where people come up to me and say, ‘I’ve seen you 80 times.’” 

In an interview with The Current’s Jill Riley, Adam Weiner talks about how much those interactions with fans mean to him, and how he works to reciprocate that dedication to fans in his music. Hear more from Adam in the video above.
